reason: In pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:109-117 the limit check calls CountDevices (its own WithDbSession, lines 158-166), and the upsert then runs in a separate WithDbSession at lines 149-153 with no transaction, mutex or server lock around the pair. Concurrent requests or HA instances can each read count < limit and each insert a new device, overshooting the limit.
